episode_title: #234 Indisk Tech Som Bot För Baissen

recommendations.speaker: Niklas
recommendations.reasoning: Indian online travel company near profitability with reopening catalyst and Indian listing potential, but unproven turnaround and dilution risk
recommendations.quote: Jag tycker inte att man ska rusa in med huvudet först... Man kan absolut vänta in och titta, låta det gå något kvartal eller två för att se om det här ser bevis på en omställning

summary: Market Makers discusses macro uncertainty with inflation impacting tech companies and consumer discretionary. They analyze Jattra (Yatra), an Indian online travel company showing signs of turnaround with 50% revenue growth and approaching profitability. Key catalysts include India's reopening and a potential dual listing, though risks include dilution from capital raise and inflation impact on travel demand.
key_takeaways: Inflation pressures both demand and costs for tech companies
Volatility clusters - best and worst market days often occur together
Jattra showing 50% YoY revenue growth with narrowing losses
Company plans Indian listing to boost valuation and access local capital
Travel industry rebounding with India domestic travel at 90% of pre-COVID levels
